crisisPressure.confidenceNote: Dispersion band, not a certainty score: the weighted standard deviation of the component scores, scaled by 0.4 and clamped 2-15. Higher means the inputs disagree with each other more, not that the reading is more certain; lower means they agree. Method: https://straits.live/methodology#confidence

degraded.note: insuranceMultiple (nominal 25%, stale) stood down because the figure is older than 14 days (report dated 2026-10-07). Nominal weight redistributed across the remaining fresh components: the published component weights are renormalized, not the methodology defaults.

reconciliation.note: Components sum to rawComposite (Σ score × weight). An override then applied: one component scored 75 or more, so the composite became max(component) × 0.9 = preDecayValue (88.55), which is what the smoothing below acts on. While an override is active the other components do not move the published value. The published value applies anti-whipsaw smoothing: asymmetric decay (36h halflife) then per-24h rails (max +25 / -10). smoothedValue rounds to value (89). Method: https://straits.live/methodology#index-smoothing
